facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary endpoint across all tumor types; subgroup signals in breast/respiratory · Phase 3 · crofelemer in cancer therapy-related diarrhea · not yet approved for this use
facts.indication: prophylaxis of cancer therapy-related diarrhea in solid tumor patients on targeted therapy

evidence.summary: The initial results from the OnTarget study show that the multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled pivotal clinical trial did not meet its primary endpoint for the prespecified analysis of all tumor types in the trial.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The initial results from the OnTarget study show that the multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled pivotal clinical trial did not meet its primary endpoint for the prespecified analysis of all tumor types in the trial.
evidence.safety: Crofelemer was well tolerated in OnTarget, and the adverse event profile was similar to placebo.
evidence.program_discontinued: We will continue to review data from prespecified and non-prespecified OnTarget subgroups and then engage in discussions with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
